stories.title: Motorista diz que se distraiu com celular antes de acidente que matou motociclista em João Pessoa, afirma defesa

en.title: Driver says he was distracted by cell phone before accident that killed motorcyclist in João Pessoa, according to defense
en.summary: A driver accused of causing a fatal collision with a motorcyclist in João Pessoa denied performing a dangerous maneuver, claiming he was distracted before the crash. The suspect surrendered to police and is scheduled for a custody hearing.

stories.title: Rotatória da Avenida Transbrasiliana, em Goiânia, é retirada para instalação de semáforos; veja previsão de obras

en.title: Roundabout on Transbrasiliana Avenue in Goiânia is removed for traffic light installation; see construction timeline
en.summary: Goiânia city government is removing a roundabout at the intersection of Transbrasiliana and Feira de Santana avenues in the Parque Amazônia neighborhood and replacing it with traffic lights. The project, which began on Saturday, is expected to take approximately one month to complete.

en.summary: A Ferrari previously owned by Michael Jordan that inspired a sneaker design has been sold for 15 million Brazilian reals.

en.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio Bolsonaro has 52% of valid votes, and Lula, 48%
en.summary: A BTG/Nexus poll released on Tuesday shows Flávio Bolsonaro with 52 percent of valid votes and Lula with 48 percent in the presidential race.

stories.title: Fim da escala 6x1: o que acontece se o Senado aprovar a PEC nesta quarta

en.title: End of 6x1 work shift: what happens if the Senate approves the PEC on Wednesday
en.summary: The Brazilian Senate is voting on a constitutional amendment that would reduce the maximum workweek from 44 to 40 hours and guarantee two paid rest days per week without salary reduction. The measure has already passed the Chamber of Deputies and Senate committee review.

stories.title: Fim da escala 6x1 volta ao Senado nesta terça (13), com disputa entre governo e oposição; veja o que pode mudar

en.title: End of 6x1 work schedule returns to Senate on Tuesday (13), with dispute between government and opposition; see what may change
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Senate resumes analysis of a constitutional amendment proposal that would eliminate the 6x1 work schedule, where employees work five days for one day off. Five ordinary sessions remain before the proposal is voted on.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera votos do pai em todas as rendas, e Lula cresce entre mais ricos

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surpasses father's votes across all income levels, and Lula grows among the richest
en.summary: Lula lost votes across most income distribution compared to the 2022 first round, except among the top 4% richest where he gained support, while Flávio Bolsonaro outperforms his father across all income brackets.

en.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio has 52%, and Lula, 48% in first second-round poll
en.summary: A BTG/Nexus poll released today shows voting intentions for a runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's presidential election, with Flávio leading at 52% versus Lula's 48%.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs abandona cenário de dólar acima de R$ 5

en.title: Goldman Sachs abandons scenario of dollar above R$ 5
en.summary: Following first-round election results, Goldman Sachs significantly revised its currency projections and adopted optimistic assumptions for the Brazilian real, removing its scenario of the dollar exceeding R$ 5.

stories.title: Terça-feira é ‘dia de escritório’, aponta pesquisa

en.title: Tuesday is 'office day', research shows
en.summary: Research indicates that Tuesday has the highest office attendance among hybrid work companies, reaching 100% occupancy, while Friday sees the lowest turnout with only 45% of workers present.

stories.title: Vaivém sobre canal a favor de Lula expõe tensão no TSE

en.title: Back-and-forth over pro-Lula channel exposes tension at TSE
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court's special misinformation unit found no fake news sharing in the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel after analyzing it, contradicting an earlier deletion order that was subsequently reversed by the electoral justice ombudsman.

stories.title: Candidatos têm de deixar claro como enfrentarão questão fiscal

en.title: Candidates must clarify how they will address fiscal issue
en.summary: Brazil's public debt increased 10 percentage points during Lula's third term, reaching 82.9% of GDP, while candidates in the upcoming election avoid presenting clear plans for necessary fiscal adjustment.
